literal: Departing guest having cared for, coming guest having looked for he who will be, good guest to the heavenly beings.
translation: He who cares for the departing guest and waits for the coming guest will be a welcome guest to the heavenly beings.
modern: சென்ற விருந்தினரை உபசரித்து வழியனுப்பிவிட்டு, இனி வரும் விருந்தினரை எதிர்பார்த்திருப்பவன், வானுலகத்தில் உள்ள தேவர்களுக்கும் நல்ல விருந்தினன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the continuous nature of true hospitality. A virtuous householder does not stop at serving one guest; after warmly sending off a departing guest, they immediately look forward to welcoming the next. Such a person, who makes hospitality their life's constant practice, will themselves be welcomed as an honored guest by the celestial beings in heaven. The word 'வருந்து' in the provided text functions as a variant of 'விருந்து', meaning guest.
